review_notes: I read the whole file and the definitions of WeakTestFunction.partialDeriv, vlConv, vlDeriv and vlConv_apply_swap, and I grepped for uses of WeakTestFunction.partialDeriv in other files. The only simp-interface problem I found is the missing unfolding lemma for WeakTestFunction.partialDeriv. I did not report vlConv_apply_swap, which is not a simp lemma, because making it one could expand every convolution. I could not run Lean, so I make no claim that the proposed lemma has compiled. The size of the improvement is uncertain: the lemma would mostly shorten the call sites.

findings.problem: `WeakTestFunction.partialDeriv` is a bare definition with no simp or unfolding lemma, such as one stating `φ.partialDeriv i x = fderiv ℝ φ.toFun x (basisVec i)`. Every user therefore unfolds it by name together with the local `let ψ`. This file does so at line 53 and again at line 98 (`simpa [Measure.restrict_univ, WeakTestFunction.partialDeriv, ψ] using this`). The same call-site unfolding appears in JSpace.lean, RegUniformMomentum.lean, ForcedRegularisedTransportField.lean and ForcePressureGradientClosure.lean. Because the unfolding is requested ad hoc, each call site decides separately whether to expose the raw `fderiv … (basisVec i)` form. Users with a concrete structure literal also have to unfold `ψ` and rely on `toFun` reducing by projection.
findings.proposed_change: In TestFunction.lean, next to the definition, add `theorem WeakTestFunction.partialDeriv_def (φ : WeakTestFunction U) (i : Fin d) (x : Vec d) : φ.partialDeriv i x = fderiv ℝ φ.toFun x (basisVec i) := rfl`. Mark it `@[simp]` only if downstream code wants the unfolded form as the normal form, which is not clear. Otherwise leave it unmarked and cite it as `simp only [WeakTestFunction.partialDeriv_def]`. Also consider a structure-literal lemma for `partialDeriv`, so that `ψ.partialDeriv i y` for a literal `ψ` reduces to `fderiv ℝ (fun y => η (x - y)) y (basisVec i)` without unfolding `ψ` by hand. The call sites would then stop depending on the definition's body.
findings.benefit: The unfolding becomes one named, uniform rewrite instead of repeated ad hoc `simp [WeakTestFunction.partialDeriv, ψ]` calls. Proofs such as `hpartial` and `hj` depend only on the stated equation, so they survive a change to the definition. The normal form is explicit.
